en: Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural railway station with a train of wooden carriages at the platform. A group of people stand along the platform in front of a long, low station building with a tiled roof and chimneys. There is a tall telegraph or signal pole near the train and trees and fields in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads "Siringe", and publisher information appears faintly below.
